verdict.rationale: Lighthouse positions itself as an employer-side provider handling "the petitions, timelines, and compliance behind every hire." Its Plus tier lists team-oriented features: Candidate Progress Reports, Consolidated Billing, Compliance Support and Immigrant Pathway Strategy Planning for Workforce. A case platform tracks uploads and readiness, and a Forbes AI 50 adoption claim plus a customers page that filters by "teams" point to multi-hire company use. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of a multi-case employer dashboard or team view, a named startup/scale-up program, and independent or hands-on corroboration of managing many cases at once.
